topic: Parts and Functions of the Reproductive System
key_concepts: The human reproductive system produces new individuals through reproduction
Male and female reproductive systems differ in structure and function
Hormones are responsible for adult male characteristics
Testes produce sperm cells and testosterone
Scrotum supports the testes and keeps them cooler than the body
Epididymis stores immature sperm cells until they mature
Vas deferens serves as the passageway of sperm cells from the testes
Seminal vesicles produce a sugar-rich fluid that gives sperm energy
Prostate gland secretes fluid that nourishes and protects sperm
Cowper's gland releases fluid that neutralizes acidic urine in the urethra
Urethra is the passageway for both urine and semen
